I'll start by reading the execution file and understanding the project structure.
## Result

Implemented **CAP-4** (CAP-FR-03, CAP-FR-05, CAP-CON-01, CAP-CON-03): a routed card-detail screen with title editing, direct photo replacement, non-destructive re-crop/rotation from the retained original, and confirmed deletion. Replacements preserve the card ID, write the new attachment set transactionally, and remove the old rows only after that transaction commits.

### Files created

- `src/features/cards/CardDetailPage.tsx`
- `src/features/cards/CardDetail.css`
- `src/features/cards/cardReplace.ts`
- `tests/cards/CardDetailPage.test.tsx`
- `tests/data/caseRepositoryReplace.test.ts`
- `e2e/capture.spec.ts`
- `e2e/fixtures/note.png`
- `e2e/fixtures/source.png`

### Files changed

- `src/app/routes.tsx`
- `src/data/caseRepository.ts`
- `src/domain/model.ts`
- `src/features/capture/cardImport.ts`

`docs/artifacts/CAP-4.md` was not modified. `docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` remains a pre-existing engine-generated modification.

## Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Detail reachable by URL, shows display image/title, saves title edits | Route/component tests; Playwright journey at all three viewports | Pass |
| Replace and re-crop preserve card ID with exactly one original/display/thumbnail | Component tests, repository replacement tests, Playwright IndexedDB assertions | Pass |
| Old attachments removed only after replacement transaction succeeds | Repository test injects a primary-key conflict; old set survives, metadata rolls back, retry succeeds | Pass |
| Playwright imports real PNG, rotates/crops, reloads, verifies persistence | `e2e/capture.spec.ts` with real PNGs, real IndexedDB, reloads | Pass — 3/3 projects |
| Keyboard focus visible; destructive delete requires confirmation | Tab path, computed focus outline, dialog focus/Escape assertions, 44 px browser measurements | Pass |

**Keyboard path exercised:** card heading → Tab to `Edit title` → `Replace photo` → `Crop/rotate` → `Delete card`; title dialog input focus, blank-title error, Escape restore; delete dialog initial focus on Cancel, Escape restore; crop editor open/save/cancel focus return.

**Viewports exercised:** desktop `1440x900`, tablet landscape `1280x800`, phone `390x844`.

**Accessibility evidence:** all four card actions measured at ≥44×44 in the browser; CSS contracts assert 44 px for back/text/action targets, token focus rings, polite live regions, reduced-motion removal, 4.5:1 paper-badge contrast, no raw palette literals, and no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

## Validation

- `npm test -- tests/cards/CardDetailPage.test.tsx` → **13 passed**
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/capture.spec.ts` → **3 passed** (desktop, tablet-landscape, phone; includes production build)
- `npm test` → **413 passed / 30 files**
- `npm run typecheck` → pass
- `npm run lint` → pass
- `npm run format:check` → pass
- Production build → pass

## Handoff notes

- `CaseRepositoryPort` now exposes `replaceCardAttachments` and `listAttachments`; `CardWithAttachments` may report `cleanupPending` when post-commit old-row cleanup fails. Data-engineer should review the optional card metadata fields (`crop`, `rotation`, `retainFullResolution`) for backup/archive preservation.
- `src/app/routes.tsx` now accepts `cardRepository` / `loadCardRepository`; preserve these when adding board/list routes.
- The case board is still the foundation placeholder, so board-engineer must add the card tap-through to `/case/:caseId/card/:cardId` when replacing it. The route itself and the complete capture→detail journey are verified.
- No OCR or connection actions were added.

handoff.summary: Implemented CAP-4 card detail with title edit, replace, re-crop, confirmed delete, persisted crop/rotation, transactional attachment replacement, 13 component/route tests, 2 data replacement tests, and a real-PNG Playwright journey passing at desktop, tablet, and phone viewports.
decisions: Card crop, rotation, and full-resolution preference are optional persisted card fields; card import now forwards the processed values so re-crop survives reload.

Replacement writes the new original/display/thumbnail and card metadata in one transaction, then removes previous attachment rows after commit; cleanup failure is reported without discarding the new image.
Replace photo processes a newly selected file as full-frame upright; Crop/rotate regenerates derivatives from the retained original using the stored crop and rotation.
tests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/capture.spec.ts: 3 passed at desktop, tablet-landscape, phone
warnings: The case board is still the foundation placeholder; card tap-through must be wired by board-engineer. The route and full capture-to-detail journey are verified.
Playwright evidence uses Chromium-based projects only; Firefox/WebKit card-detail behavior is not covered by this task.
A post-commit cleanup failure can leave unreferenced old attachment rows while reporting cleanupPending; the normal path leaves exactly three current rows.
docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl has a pre-existing engine-generated modification that was not authored or touched.
validationLimitations: Browser rotation/crop behavior was verified in Chromium only.
The replacement cleanupPending failure branch is handled and typed but not exercised in the browser journey.
